svg.title: GraphSketcher sidebar study — light and dark
svg.desc: Two 520 by 440 graph canvases with 280 point scrolling sidebars, four icon and label sections, existing Style controls, scroll continuation, and seven original glyphs. Design only.
svg.text: A graph first. Its controls within reach.
14–16pt padding; fixed icon + label section selector.
Both need vertical scrolling below the section selector.
Control appearance is illustrative; native semantics follow integration.
